description: This file defines a class for supplier scorecard variables, including validation logic and multiple functions to calculate various metrics related to purchase orders, receipts, shipments, RFQs, and supplier performance within a specified period.

classes.name: VariablePathNotFound
classes.description: Custom exception class for validation errors related to missing or incorrect variable paths.

classes.name: SupplierScorecardVariable
classes.description: Main class representing a supplier scorecard variable, with validation logic to verify the existence of the specified path.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates the object by checking if the specified path exists.

methods.name: validate_path_exists
methods.description: Checks if the path attribute exists either as a dot in self.path and importable, or as an attribute in the module.

methods.name: get_total_workdays
methods.description: Calculates total days in the period defined by scorecard's start and end dates.

methods.name: get_item_workdays
methods.description: Calculates total item workdays based on purchase order items and quantities.

methods.name: get_total_cost_of_shipments
methods.description: Calculates total cost of shipments within the period based on purchase order items.

methods.name: get_cost_of_delayed_shipments
methods.description: Calculates total cost of delayed shipments by subtracting on-time shipment costs from total shipment costs.

methods.name: get_cost_of_on_time_shipments
methods.description: Calculates total cost of on-time shipments based on purchase receipts.

methods.name: get_total_days_late
methods.description: Calculates total late days based on purchase receipts vs purchase orders.

methods.name: get_on_time_shipments
methods.description: Counts the number of on-time shipments based on purchase receipts.

methods.name: get_late_shipments
methods.description: Calculates the number of late shipments.

methods.name: get_total_received
methods.description: Counts total received shipments in the period.

methods.name: get_total_received_amount
methods.description: Calculates total amount received in the period.

methods.name: get_total_received_items
methods.description: Counts total received items in the period.

methods.name: get_total_rejected_amount
methods.description: Calculates total rejected amount in the period.

methods.name: get_total_rejected_items
methods.description: Counts total rejected items in the period.

methods.name: get_total_accepted_amount
methods.description: Calculates total accepted amount in the period.

methods.name: get_total_accepted_items
methods.description: Counts total accepted items in the period.

methods.name: get_total_shipments
methods.description: Counts total ordered shipments scheduled in the period.

methods.name: get_rfq_total_number
methods.description: Counts total RFQs sent to the supplier.

methods.name: get_rfq_total_items
methods.description: Counts total RFQ items sent to the supplier.

methods.name: get_sq_total_number
methods.description: Counts total supplier quotations sent to the supplier.

methods.name: get_sq_total_items
methods.description: Counts total supplier quotation items sent to the supplier.

methods.name: get_rfq_response_days
methods.description: Calculates total days taken by supplier to respond to RFQs.
